relucent.definition:
a. Reflecting light; shining; glittering; glistening;
   bright; luminous; splendid.
relucent.translation: a. 光辉的, 明亮的

reluct.definition:
v. i. To strive or struggle against anything; to make
   resistance; to draw back; to feel or show repugnance or reluctance.

reluctance.definition:
n. (physics) opposition to magnetic flux (analogous to electric resistance)
n. a certain degree of unwillingness
reluctance.translation:
n. 不情愿, 勉强
[电] 磁阻

reluctant.definition:
s. disinclined to become involved
s. not eager
reluctant.translation:
a. 不情愿的, 勉强的
[法] 不愿的, 勉强的, 难以处理的

reluctantly.translation: adv. 不情愿地, 勉强地

reluctate.definition: v. i. To struggle against anything; to resist; to oppose.
reluctate.translation: vi. 向...反抗, 不同意, 表示勉强

reluctation.translation: n. 表示不愿意, 表示勉强

reluctivity.definition: n (physics) the resistance of a material to the establishment of a magnetic field in it

reluctometer.translation: 磁阻签质仪(检查钢制品质量)

relume.definition: v. t. To rekindle; to light again.
relume.translation: vt. 再燃起, 再照亮, 使再明亮

relumed.translation: v. 重新点燃起, 重新照亮( relume的过去式和过去分词 )

relumine.definition:
v. t. To light anew; to rekindle.
v. t. To illuminate again.
relumine.translation: vt. 重新点燃, 使重新照亮, 使重新明亮

relumined.translation:
重新点燃
使…重新照亮

reluming.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Relume
reluming.translation: v. 重新点燃起, 重新照亮( relume的现在分词 )

relumining.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Relumine
relumining.translation:
重新点燃
使…重新照亮
